text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hoo boy... My feet're throbb'n someth'n
fierce.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I found some real jazzy shoes
yesterday and
just couldn't help m'self.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not used to walk'n in high heels,
though. I'm
plain pooped here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'm just not cut out for shoes like
these...
Phew... I really gotta loosen up
my legs before
train'n.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking exhausted, Yukino Bijin begins

massaging her legs.
